newsitem.title: FRANCE: Naomi Campbell back to work after drug scare-agent.
newsitem.headline: Naomi Campbell back to work after drug scare-agent.

text.p: - British supermodel Naomi Campbell returned to work in Paris on Monday after receiving emergency treatment in a Canary Islands hospital, her agent said.

Xavier Moreau of Elite modelling agency told Reuters that Campbell had suffered an allergy to antibiotics. "It was an allergy to antibiotics, she didn't take barbiturates," he said. "She has resumed her activities."
The 26-year-old model was taken semi-conscious from her five-star hotel on Gran Canaria early on Sunday and rushed to the Nuestra Senora del Pino hospital.

A hospital official said Campbell had been admitted to intensive care after some kind of "overdose". After her release on Sunday evening, the supermodel flew back to Paris, where she landed early on Monday aboard a chartered Swiss-registered private aircraft.

Moreau said he had spoken to Campbell on the phone and she was fine. "It's much ado about nothing. The proof is she is not in the hospital," he said. "At first we thought it was appendicitis. She had stomach cramps."
Local media on the Canary Islands had reported that Campbell had had an argument with her boyfriend, 28-year-old flamenco dancer Joaquin Cortes.
